title: dianthus cintranus subsp. charidemi
intro: Dianthus cintranus subsp. charidemi, commonly known as the Iberian pink, is a species of flowering plant in the carnation family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to support health, with potential benefits including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Dianthus cintranus subsp. charidemi include its antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory properties, making it a potential natural remedy for various health issues. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
